options.name: items
options.type: readonly { id: string; title: string; content: Node | string; disabled?: boolean }[]
options.description: Items with unique ids. Titles and string content render as text.

options.name: value
options.description: Expanded item ids (at most one when multiple is false).

options.name: multiple
options.description: Allow several panels open at once; otherwise expanding one collapses the others.

options.name: collapsible
options.description: Single mode: the open panel can be collapsed. When false its header is aria-disabled.

options.name: headingLevel
options.description: Heading element wrapping each header button.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Expanded item ids, in item order.

methods.name: panel
methods.description: Content container of an item's panel.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expand programmatically (no events); collapses others in single mode.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapse programmatically (no events), even when not collapsible.

events.name: aui-change
events.detail: { value: string[]; id: string; expanded: boolean }
events.description: The user expanded or collapsed an item.

cssClasses.name: aui-accordion--animated
cssClasses.description: Set after the first toggle; enables the expand transition.

cssClasses.name: aui-accordion__panel
cssClasses.description: Panel (region when six items or fewer).

cssClasses.name: aui-accordion__clip
cssClasses.description: Grid row that clips content during the height transition.
